component_values.J28: Misc analog input 1 (panel BNC, /1//2 selectable) -- /1//2 shunt header, BOTH legs (fix round 3, task-10b-report.md): column A (pins 1,3,5) = SIGNAL leg raw/div/mid, column B (pins 2,4,6) = SHIELD leg raw/div/mid -- confirmed 2.54mm-pitch adjacent pairs on the REAL PinHeader_2x03_P2.54mm_Vertical footprint (kicad-cli fp export svg + kicad_pcb.footprint_pads(), not just the schematic symbol -- fix round 2's Conn_02x03_Top_Bottom/row assignment assumed a pin adjacency this footprint does not actually have). Populate with ONE 2-GANG SHORTING BLOCK spanning both columns at the same row-pair -- pins 1-3 + 2-4 for x1 (direct), pins 3-5 + 4-6 for x2 (divider tap) -- NEVER two independent 1-gang shunts: that is the exact defect this header replaces (fix round 1 left it physically possible for the two legs' own jumpers to disagree; a mechanically-ganged 2-gang block makes disagreement physically impossible instead of merely documented against).
